items.text: SEASON 5 · EPISODE 11 · BOSS LEVEL · DRAFT  Campus-wide multi-building failure · Level 2  Brackenmoor, exam week, 8:05 a.m. A campus-wide network change went wrong overnight: lecture capture records silence in forty rooms, the hospital's telehealth carts are freezing, and severe weather is coming.  ⚑ CH-01 · BOSS-01: five physics challenges, a signal trace and the calls that aren't yours to make — on the clock. Fail anything and the run starts over. The edge of the screen glows yellow under pressure, red when time is short or the run fails, green when you clear it; it pulses no faster than once a second, and holds steady if you prefer reduced motion.

lines.text: One check per stage. If it fails, we start over from the top — and we'll know why.
Then we start again. That's the job: until it passes, and we can prove it.

narration: By noon the capture is recording, the carts are stable, the alert went out as issued and the panel is on the record. Wes writes the post-incident review in the wiki — every step, with names.
items.caption: Cleared. Written down. Handed over.

items.text: FIELD NOTE —  Under pressure, the method doesn't change: trace the signal from source to destination, fix one thing at a time and prove it where the people are, and hand every decision that isn't yours to the person who owns it — the electrician, the rigger and structural engineer, the network owner, security, the emergency managers, the clinical and privacy owners, the artist. Then write it down.
